2.why: "Up to £2,206 per module" is one figure and a cadence this repository does not model. `_numbers_in` returns a single number, so `range_low`/`range_high` both decline (they require exactly two) and no band is built. A per-module rate is also not convertible to any `Period` we carry: the number of modules is the part the advert does not state, so inventing an annual figure from it would be a guess presented as the employer's own number.
